intro: Keldran is an orc operative stationed just north of the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. Dedicated to paving the way for eventual diplomacy with the Alliance, he coordinates covert strikes against demonic remnants to prove the modern Horde has truly forsaken the Burning Legion.

p: While Thrall governs from the Valley of Wisdom, Keldran works from the city's red rock terraces to solve a lingering diplomatic disaster. The Alliance still views all orcs as bloodthirsty puppets of demonic masters, a reputation cemented during the first wars. Convinced that even Thrall tires of endless conflict, Keldran believes true peace talks can never occur while demon-worshiping cults endure in Kalimdor. Without formal sanction from the Warchief, he takes the initiative upon himself, directing trusted agents toward distant threats to dismantle the demonic stain once and for all.
